scope: Same authored byte-for-byte literal controller operations, checkpoint start, standard quality, subdued intensity, viewport and FOV. Current/baseline controller successes and refusals are retained. Actual ChapterScene/actor/mirror rendering in software WebGL; no native UI, GL presentation or human play/listening claim.

reports.cameraComparisonBoundary: Same literal controls and starting pose. Actual camera divergence from each revision’s collision, held-action and completion rules is retained. Frames before the first difference have numerically equal cameras; later frames are same-input outcomes, not same-pose art comparisons.
reports.actorComparisonBoundary: Actor simulation runs independently against each authored world. Actor poses can differ as a consequence of changed collision/LOS and control timing; this is not an equal-actor-pose turntable.
